Aditya — thanks for the materials and the clear asks. I looped in our procurement lead and legal. Initial reactions from our side:
- The 12-month bridge is acceptable in principle but procurement needs clarity on automatic renewal language on the order form. Can you confirm whether the bridge term will auto-renew or explicitly expire?
- Legal flagged the indemnity change — they asked whether Redwood will accept a carve that preserves customer data confidentiality obligations in addition to IP.
- Pricing table: our CFO prefers a monthly metered fallback vs a strict seat split for the first 3 months to avoid overcommit. Can you share the math that produced Option B?

We will consolidate internal comments and get a marked-up MSA back by Thursday EOD. If LAUREN from Redwood Legal needs to weigh in before then, please include her.

Folks — forwarding Sara's reply. Quick internal suggested positions so we can respond cleanly:

- Bridge term: accept 12 months but require explicit non-renewal language on the MSA (so Bridge expires unless both parties sign a renewal). This protects staging cadence.
- Indemnity/data confidentiality: we can accept confidentiality carve but push back on expanding Redwood's liability beyond third-party IP/tort. Suggest the language in OliveTech_MSA_v3_redline at 3.4 (our compromise annotation).
- Pricing fallback: agree to a monthly metered fallback for months 1–3 with a 10% premium vs committed seats to deter overuse; attach revised order form with both lines (metered fallback + phased seat split).

Action items: Lauren — please review the indemnity wording in the redline and either accept or propose insurer-friendly edits. Naomi — want you on the reply to validate the billing fallback math. Aditya — I can take the call with procurement tomorrow 2pm PT if helpful.

Aditya / Ben / Sara / OliveTech Legal — thanks for the context. A few legal notes and a proposed redline excerpt I recommend we try to agree on:

1) Term/renewal (Section 2): We will commit to a 12-month bridge that expires on its face. We will accept a separate mutual renewal clause on the order form only if the order form clearly requires affirmative signature for renewal (no automatic rollovers). Proposed language: "Bridge Term shall expire on the date set forth in the Order Form and shall not renew except by mutual written agreement signed by authorized representatives of both parties."

2) Indemnity & data confidentiality: We can accept a confidentiality-preserving carve so long as Redwood's indemnity exposure remains capped and tied to third-party IP claims. Proposed addition to Section 9: "Notwithstanding anything to the contrary, Customer Confidential Information shall not be considered a basis for indemnity claims that exceed the limitations of liability set forth in Section 10."

3) Pricing fallback: Operationally acceptable. We need the spreadsheet to show the pricing delta and an explicit billing metric for the metered fallback (tokens/requests). Naomi, please confirm the token bands and the 10% premium.

If OliveTech Legal sends a marked MSA, I will track line-by-line and mark accept/decline. For speed, I suggest we aim for a 30-minute call Thursday 11am PT (Legal + Procurement + Aditya/Ben + me).

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
